svg.text: Delivery and security: private bucket served only through CloudFront
Why it is built this way
• CloudFront signs each request to S3, so the bucket stays private while images still load fast from edge locations.
• The bucket policy has a SourceArn condition: only this one distribution can read, nobody else on the internet.
• Layers of protection: Block Public Access, the bucket policy, HTTPS only, encryption at rest and least-privilege IAM roles.
